steps.label: Obtain a written reviewer quote <= $80 per plan including 2 re-checks within 30 days, 24h turnaround, capacity 2/day (requires supplier-contact authorization); no outreach before it
Register the brand domain for reply-to and the sample link
Buy ~5,000 Maps records (500 free + 4,500 at $3/1k); keep firms with an E-2 page and a published address (up to 800)

Email up to 800 qualified firms at <= 200/day, days 1-4, through Brain's integrated sending infrastructure (the Instantly integration the owner allowed as Brain infrastructure; none of its campaign history is used as evidence)

Intake; only 2 orders are accepted before proof, later intakes are waitlisted until proof; terms: 2 revision rounds in 30 days (both re-runs reserved at intake), written approval or rejection within 5 business days, rejection = no charge
Draft on the API, reviewer checks before delivery (two proof orders)
steps.performer: Contracted E-2 plan reviewer (quote required by s0)

steps.label: Pay the reviewer per plan on completion

validation.proof: by day 22: >= 2 ACH-cleared payments >= $1,250 from 2 distinct payers, and the first plan approved in writing by its attorney
stop: day 0: no reviewer quote <= $80 incl. 2 re-checks -> no outreach (NO_PLAN for fulfilment); $0 spent

day 22: fewer than 2 cleared payments (pending included) -> stop new intake; open orders are completed and their reserved revision rounds honoured; at most $287 spent ($227 paid out, $60 of revision re-runs reserved); no further spending
continue: day 22 proof met -> release up to $1,713 ($2,000 - $287) for waitlisted orders at <= $130 each (API $15, review $80, two re-runs $30, ACH fee $5); only prepaying clients can clear by day 30, so $10,000 in this window needs >= 6 waitlisted clients to prepay by ~day 26 — stated as unlikely on this cycle, not as supported
